checklist.evidence: Treat `0000:00:00 00:00:00`, empty values and dates before 1990 or in the future as missing.
`subsec`: add sub-seconds when the camera records them ... `suffix`: add a counter in capture order
First rename everything to temporary names ... Skip files whose name already matches the target, so repeat runs change nothing.
Save a JSON file of `{old, new, tmp}` entries. `--undo` reads this log and reverses each rename.
QuickTime `CreateDate` is often stored in **UTC**, so it has to be converted to local time.
RAW + JPEG pairs ... Sidecar files (`IMG_1.xmp`, `IMG_1.JPG.xmp`, `IMG_1.AAE`) ... Live Photos
Replace characters Windows doesn't allow (`<>:"/\|?*`). This is why the default format uses `-` instead of `:` in times.
